### The Purpose of the Parables
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/purpose-parables
Passage: Matthew 13:12-17
Points:
- Jesus spoke in parables both to unveil kingdom truth to believers and conceal it from hardened hearts.
- Rejection of Jesus' teaching stems from moral and willful refusal to trust Him rather than intellectual incomprehension.
- God sovereignly uses parabolic teaching to reveal rebellion and confirm judgment while holding sinners responsible.
- Spiritual perception and faith are unmerited gifts of divine grace rather than human achievements.
- Believers granted eyes to see kingdom truth should respond with deep humility and thanksgiving.
